style_guide.basis: Conventions v1.0 section 6 and decisions D3-D8, D11 (confirmed 2026-11-24).

numbering.rule: Keep the content-list output number and order verbatim; never renumber.

decimals.rule: Raw-data precision d: mean and median d+1; SD and SE d+2; min and max d; percentages 1 decimal; p-values 3 decimals with '<0.001'.
decimals.placeholder_rendering: Placeholders show the default widths above; actual d is a study setting per variable.

abbreviations.rule: One library-wide list; expand at first use in the footnotes of each output.

list.CTCAE: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events
list.N: number of subjects in the analysis population
list.n: number of subjects with data or in the category

order: marker footnotes in order of first appearance (a, b, c ...)
general notes: population definition, denominator, coding dictionary, abbreviations
program path and run date line

programming_notes.content_rule: Display rules only (repeat, sort, paging, same-layout references); never statistical algorithms.

templates.name: Variable distribution summary
